chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), was in Kufa, riding the mule of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Then he passed by the fish market and said: 'Do not eat and do not sell from the fish that do not have scales.

key_terms.بَغْلَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The mule of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating fish without scales according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi records Imam Ali (peace be upon him) issuing a public decree in Kufa to prohibit the consumption and trade of scaleless fish, reflecting the early juristic consensus on the criteria for halal seafood. By delivering this ruling while riding the Prophet’s mule in the bustling fish market, the Imam demonstrated the practical application of fiqh in daily commerce, establishing a precedent for distinguishing between permissible and impermissible aquatic creatures based on physical characteristics.
